title: How Does Your Phone Know Your Location?

scenes.text: Your phone can pinpoint your location

scenes.label: GPS SATELLITES
scenes.text: It uses GPS satellites to determine your location

scenes.label: NETWORK TRIANGULATION
scenes.text: It can also use Wi-Fi and cellular networks to improve accuracy

scenes.label: SENSOR DATA
scenes.text: It can even use sensor data from your phone's accelerometer and gyroscope
Follow for daily tech and AI news.

description: Have you ever wondered how your phone knows your location? It uses a combination of GPS satellites, Wi-Fi, and cellular networks, as well as sensor data from your phone's accelerometer and gyroscope. Follow us for more tech explanations.
